scope: Static closure of one mapped-gate replay TB, one DUT-only UCLI capture controller, one future fail-closed sequential runner, one per-case SAIF validator and directed static tests for the sealed M872 C2 three-axis workload.

static_evidence.future_attempt_consumption: canonical mkdir is irreversible; incomplete canonical attempts permanently block retry
static_evidence.future_failure_quarantine: recursive seal before move; retain original work if seal or move fails

saif_policy.window: accepted header through one clock after accepted token_done
saif_policy.nonzero_cases: clock, header/raw, memory request/response, accumulator/result and token_done cones must all toggle
saif_policy.zero_event_case: memory cone may remain zero; requiring artificial memory activity is forbidden

p1_findings: The mapped netlist flattened-vector port orientation is a source hypothesis until a fresh mapped-gate compile passes numeric, tuple and frozen-cycle gates.
No real SAIF exists yet; actual UCLI scope, exact duration, hierarchy coverage and TX=0 remain future execution gates.
